description: Mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) per monitor over a date window, in seconds. Already per-monitor — pass all monitors at once in monitor_uuids rather than calling this once per monitor.

from.description: ISO start date. Default: 30 days ago.

monitor_uuids.description: Monitor UUIDs to report on. Pass EVERY monitor you care about in a SINGLE call: the endpoint resolves them in one aggregate query and returns a per-monitor breakdown, so N monitors in one call costs about the same as one. Looping over monitors and calling this once each is roughly N times more expensive and will hit the rate limit. Omit to cover the whole project.

name: get_monitor_mtta
title: Get MTTA per monitor
